cc:Work.dc:title: Misc - AirPurifier
cc:Work.dc:description:
Housing for the Nukit Open Air Purifier
See [Nukit Open Air Purifier](https://github.com/opennukit/Nukit-Open-Air-Purifier/)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes AirPurifier --x 300 --y 280 --filter_height 30 --rim 20 --fan_diameter 120 --filters 1 --split_frames 0 --fans_left 2 --fans_right 0 --fans_top -1 --fans_bottom 1 --screw_holes 4.5 --thickness 4 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes AirPurifier --x --y --filter_height --rim --fan_diameter --filters --split_frames --fans_left --fans_right --fans_top --fans_bottom --screw_holes --thickness --reference --labels
